name: Templar Oaths held on the Oath Chain last as long as the refreshed chain (#9922)
contract: Every Oath grant refreshes Oath Chain 704576 to its 15000 ms duration (#9506), and the chain's removal clears
every Oath. The Oaths themselves last 10 min in Spell.dbc and hide their duration (SPELL_ATTR5_DO_NOT_DISPLAY_DURATION),
so they belong to the chain rather than timing out on their own. GrantOath gave only the newly granted Oath the
chain's duration, so an Oath of another type kept its older timer and expired while the refreshed chain stayed up.
Expected: after Righteous Lunge grants Oath: Righteous Lunge 804904 and Condemn grants Oath: Condemn 804922 6 s
later, 804904 carries the refreshed chain's remaining duration and is still held 10 s after Condemn, when its
original 15 s timer would have run out, together with the chain.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the first Oath's timer run down
THE FIX: the older Oath follows the refreshed chain instead of its stale 9 s remainder
Outlast the first Oath's original 15 s timer
THE FIX: the older Oath is still held while the chain is up
